_comment: Defaults the app pre-fills into section 7 on first run. The secret must match CONFIG.SHARED_SECRET in apps-script/flip-scout-agent-sheet.gs. The URL is the canonical public form of the deployment (script.google.com/macros/s/<id>/exec) - the /a/macros/<domain>/ variant only works for signed-in Workspace users and will hit a Google login wall.
